searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "SimCLR" from February 2020, "Idefics2" from April 2024, "Phi 3 Vision" from May 2024, and "GPT-4.5" from February 2025, all available on GitHub. Morgan Stanley's research includes papers on Langevin Thompson Sampling, average-case hardness of parity problems, and a manifold view of adversarial risk. Towards Data Science highlights a fast GPU implementation and a paper on small language models for agentic AI. GeeksforGeeks lists "Attention Is All You Need" as a must-read, along with other foundational papers. YouTube's deep learning monitor is recommended for real-time information on hot and fresh papers.
